oracle: Dedicated Playwright test-browser Chromium 153 headless shell; all requests are blocked; the pinned Chart.js 4.5.1 UMD is loaded inline in capture runs.

captureNotes.html: Each case includes complete authored HTML with omitted canvas width/height attributes, its requested CSS sizing, and script tags for /chart.js and /chart-responsive-driver.js. The driver source is stored separately for a local route.
captureNotes.driver: The shared driver constructs the stock Chart.js bar chart and publishes an initial JSON report into #probe after two animation frames. The Resize +20px button changes only the container width; the report includes an after-two-frame state plus a settled state after Chart.js resize debounce and two more frames.
captureNotes.apiTrace: Browser-only property and API wrappers forward directly to native descriptors and methods. The traces record the actual initialization and button-resize sequences, including canvas bitmap/style writes and computed-style, bounding-rect, offset-size, and client-size reads. Wrapper code is not in the shared driver or Chart.js.
captureNotes.probe: The stock driver reports constructor failures separately from initial or resized measurement errors. Browser probes are captured from #probe; resizeProbe.state is settled and resizeProbe.timing.afterTwoAnimationFrames.state records the first two-frame snapshot. Probe API reads may appear in trace order.
captureNotes.nativeComparison: This fixture records browser behavior only and makes no claim about Android native rendering or parity.
